verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents a dedicated versioning policy (SemVer 2.0.0 on the engine release line), publishes an OpenAPI spec versioned with each engine release, and documents an experimental-to-stable pathway that warns experimental APIs may break between releases. However, it states it only maintains the latest release and has no EOL or LTS policy, and the evidence shows no explicit deprecation policy with notice windows or sunset timelines. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with timelines or notice periods, EOL/LTS support for prior versions, and independent corroboration of API stability practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Meilisearch publishes a dedicated versioning policy: SemVer 2.0.0 on the engine release line (4-6 minor releases a year)
An experimental feature's API can change significantly and become incompatible between releases
